source_tar_sha256_method: remote sha256sum of fleet inbox source.tar; compared with pilot snapshot_identity.snapshot_sha256

ast_assignments.fits: measure('encoder.fit_streak', lambda: old.fit_streak(start, source, [x[4] for x in coded], (h, w)))

logic: track_of converts BallTrack.run(source) to the start positions; FrameCrops takes those positions, source RGB and decoded RGB; fit_frames refines positions and appearances by source-versus-decode crop error; global PSNR guard uses source and rendered native frames. No labels passed into this fitting chain. Labels are used in source qualification/eligibility, score_frames, and label-centered scoring crops.
judge_scope: WASB is independent of encoder model conditional on reported train/test split, training logs unaudited; BallTrack judge reuses encoder model and measures self-consistency, not an independent judge.
limitations: AST argument and manual dependency inspection, not a formal whole-program information-flow proof. Source hash and selected helper byte hashes match the archived snapshot; no GPU execution undertaken.
